arrow_magnitude: Euclidean norm of each decoded 3-D integer displacement vector; one identical linear display scale in all panels, no per-vector magnitude normalization or clipping.
display_scope: Arrows show camera-projected directions with lengths proportional to 3-D Euclidean displacement, not pixel-flow displacement. Full/share/residual 3-D vectors are exact decoded quantities.
scope:
Three comparable arrow maps: full GS motion, regional share, GS residual.

All quantities come from the same saved decoded frame. The no-sharing map is
the full per-GS motion of this fitted field, not a separately trained model.
residual_projection: project(base + shared + residual) - project(base + shared); displayed at base for correspondence.
sampling: One eligible Gaussian centre nearest each 18px grid cell centre; depth/opacity-filtered centres; no motion-magnitude selection. All three maps use identical scale and origin set. Regional arrows are one actual member per represented region, not a normalized average.
status: superseded: 3-D-norm arrow illustration must not be read as screen motion
